mo_ta_cong_viec:
Itviec's client is seeking a highly skilled Engineering Manager to lead the team and drive the development of our software products and solutions. The Engineering Manager will work closely with cross-functional teams to build scalable, efficient, innovative software applications that deliver a seamless user experience. The ideal candidate will have a strong technical background in software engineering and hands-on coding, coupled with the ability to create and execute a vision for team management, continuous process improvement, and technical excellence. The ideal candidate also has proven experience building new technology products from zero to launch, and a solid understanding of how technology is developed and adopted in manufacturing, so the platform fits real shop-floor and supply chain operations.
 
Key Responsibilities:
Team Leadership & Training: Manage, mentor, and elevate local development members through regular 1-on-1 sessions, constructive evaluation feedback, and coaching.
Product Delivery & Quality: Actively participate in the product lifecycle, contributing directly to the codebase, executing pair programming, and running robust code reviews to ensure unified implementation.
New Product Development & Innovation: Lead the creation of new technology products and features from idea to market: problem discovery, technology validation, prototyping/PoC, MVP, pilot and scale-up. Turn new ideas into working products that deliver clear business value.
Manufacturing Technology Alignment: Apply your understanding of manufacturing technology development processes (e.g., NPI, stage-gate, PoC to pilot to mass rollout, MES/ERP/PLM integration, quality and production workflows) to design solutions that fit manufacturing operations and are easy for manufacturing customers to adopt.
Architecture & Scalability: Collaborate closely with global product and engineering divisions to design, architect, and deploy highly scalable software solutions aligned with business goals.
Flexible Technical Governance: Adapt seamlessly to organizational needs, whether guiding teams through complex technical decisions with a review-centric focus or driving active on-site delivery through high-volume hands-on development.
Organization Design & Culture: Optimize internal organizational structures to match product scaling, promote engineering recruitment, participate in external PR, and actively champion a progressive tech culture.
yeu_cau:
Core Requirements (Must Have):
Proven track record as a development team manager or Engineering Manager steering product squads to deliver results from highly complex requirements.
Solid foundational background as a software engineer with hands-on coding experience, with a verified ability to develop, contribute to, and review complex codebases.
Proven experience creating and launching new technology products (0→1), from concept and technology validation through MVP to production release.
Solid understanding of technology development processes in manufacturing (e.g., NPI, stage-gate, pilot-to-scale rollout, production/quality workflows, MES/ERP/PLM systems).
Demonstrated experience navigating technology verification, requirements analysis, architectural design, and infrastructure construction for multiple projects or teams.
Strong experience driving and optimizing Agile and Scrum development workflows.
Excellent capability to balance technical and managerial responsibilities effectively to maintain high personal and team productivity.
Fluent business-level communication skills in English (cross-team collaboration is a dynamic mix of English and Japanese).
Current residency in Vietnam or concrete relocation plans (foreign nationals must possess a valid local work permit or legal eligibility).
 
Preferred Qualifications (Nice to Have):
Prior management experience working within a fast-growing, multinational, or multi-team development infrastructure.
Business-level Japanese language proficiency is highly advantageous.
Hands-on experience with manufacturing technology such as Industry 4.0, IoT, smart factory, or supply chain/procurement systems.
